qualitative_analysis.title: Inversis is the #6 depositary in Spain for FI + SICAV (3.2% of assets, CNMV 2026-Q2)
qualitative_analysis.body: Inversis holds €16.1B for 26 gestoras — €12.5B in 186 investment funds and €3.6B in 62 SICAVs. The FI + SICAV depositary market totals €508B and is led by Cecabank (43.5%) and Caceis Bank Spain (20.1%). Inversis is positioned with independent boutiques and private-banking gestoras rather than the large bank-captive books.

qualitative_analysis.title: Estimated annual depositary fee revenue: €9.5M at 5.9 bps effective rate
qualitative_analysis.body: Applying each fund’s and SICAV’s CNMV-reported depositary fee to its current assets gives €9.49M/yr. The two largest fee contributors are ANDBANK WEALTH MANAGEMENT (€2.36M) and MARCH ASSET MANAGEMENT (€1.95M), together 45% of the total.

qualitative_analysis.title: Client concentration: top 2 groups hold 64% of AUM and 59% of fee revenue
qualitative_analysis.body: Banca March group (€6.14B, €2.85M fees) and Andbank group (€4.19B, €2.75M fees) together account for 64% of assets under custody and 59% of estimated fees. Both should be treated as Tier 1 strategic accounts; pricing on the largest book is analysed in the Banca March tab.

qualitative_analysis.title: €52B addressable market outside current Inversis relationships
qualitative_analysis.body: 51 non-captive gestoras totalling €52B AUM currently use other depositaries. The most valuable non-captive targets include BESTINVER GESTION, TREA ASSET MANAGEMENT S.G.I.I.C., MAPFRE ASSET MANAGEMENT. Inversis’s competitive advantage in this segment is its independence from distribution and its operational breadth (248 funds and SICAVs across 26 gestoras).
